verdict.rationale: Casium is an immigration platform with an organization-wide case dashboard, so bulk actions across many cases or employees are a fair question. The evidence only shows viewing status across the program ('live view', 'one source of truth') and per-case task lists. Nothing documents performing actions on many items at once, and no API or OpenAPI spec was found that could support it.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
